Nigeria’s 2023 General Election is scheduled to hold in two phases beginning
with national elections (Presidential and National Assembly) on Saturday 25th
February 2023 and State elections (Governorship and State Houses of Assembly)
on Saturday 11th March 2023.

Preface

Pursuant to the provision of Section 32(1) of the Electoral Act 2022 and as
provided in the Timetable and Schedule of Activities for the 2023 General Election
released by the Commission on 26th February 2022, this publication contains
the final list of candidates nominated by the 18 political parties for State elections.
It covers Governorship candidates and their running mates for 28 out of the 36
States of the Federation. This is so because in eight States (Anambra, Bayelsa,
Edo, Ekiti, Imo, Kogi, Osun and Ondo), elections to the offices of Governors are
held off-cycle and not part of the general election. Furthermore, the publication
also covers 993 State Houses of Assembly constituencies.
The list has been published in all the relevant offices of the Commission
nationwide and simultaneously uploaded to the Commission’s website for public
information.
